clue.text: Fellows of the upper class that may be seen in restaurant

definitions.text: that may be seen in restaurant

parts.note: fellows are men
U is the old label for upper-class usage, as in 'U and non-U'

explanation.surface: Posh gentlemen dining out in a smart restaurant.
explanation.walkthrough: U for upper class comes from the 1950s 'U and non-U' debate about which words posh Britons used.
explanation.definitionFit: A bill of fare is something diners see in any restaurant, described here by where it turns up.

clue.text: Soldier number one has a psychological condition

parts.note: a para is a paratrooper
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A paratrooper, top of the class, is suffering from a mental illness.
explanation.definitionFit: Irrational suspicion and persecution fears make up a recognised mental disorder.

clue.text: Endless row about pub offering Aussie can of beer

indicators.note: about means the shortened row goes around the pub word
endless says the final letter of the word for row is cut off

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats
an inn is a pub

explanation.surface: A row breaks out around the bar over an Australian tinny.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Endless' drops the last letter of the row word; 'about' wraps what is left around the pub. A tinnie is Australian slang.
explanation.definitionFit: Australian slang for a canned beer, from the tin it comes in.

clue.text: As something before its proper time, it's not going off with a bang

definitions.text: As something before its proper time, it's not going off with a bang

parts.words: As something before its proper time, it's not going off with a bang
parts.note: a race begun too early, before the starting gun, is a premature beginning rather than a real one going off with the pistol's bang

explanation.walkthrough: 'Going off with a bang' suggests a firework that fizzles, but it is the starter's pistol in a race.
explanation.definitionFit: In athletics a runner leaving the blocks before the gun commits this foul, so the race restarts.

clue.text: Like delivery on field completed by a fighting force

parts.note: something over is finished or completed
an arm of the services, such as the air arm, is a fighting force

explanation.surface: A battle on a field won by an army.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'delivery on field' is a ball bowled on a cricket field, not a soldier's dispatch.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket, a bowler's ball sent with the arm swinging above the shoulder is described this way.

clue.text: Foreign character, very big, with nothing on top

indicators.note: on top in a down clue puts the nothing letter above the rest

parts.note: O, the zero shape, is nothing
mega means very big

explanation.surface: A huge, alien figure with nothing on its head.
explanation.definitionFit: The last letter of the Greek alphabet is a character from a foreign script.

clue.text: Man stuttered awkwardly outside university, a sort of learner

indicators.note: outside means the rearranged letters wrap around the university abbreviation
awkwardly tells us the letters of the two words are clumsily rearranged

explanation.surface: A grown man stammering nervously outside a college building.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awkwardly' rearranges MAN STUTTERED; 'outside' wraps it around U.
explanation.definitionFit: An adult who enters higher education later than usual is a particular kind of learner.

clue.text: Gosh, a little girl comes back in such a state!

indicators.note: comes back means the whole string of letters is read backwards

parts.note: oh is an exclamation like gosh
Di is a short form of the girl's name Diana

explanation.surface: A girl returns home in a terrible state, prompting a cry of surprise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comes back' reverses the whole string. 'In such a state' sounds like distress but means a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase points to a US state, here the potato-growing one in the north-west.

clue.text: Musical drama, the heartless work

parts.note: an opera is a sung musical drama

indicators.note: heartless removes the central letter of the word the

explanation.surface: A cold-hearted critic dismissing a musical drama.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' takes the middle H out of THE, leaving TE.
explanation.definitionFit: To run or function, as a machine does, is to work.

clue.text: Transformed female, amused when changing

indicators.note: changing tells us the letters of amused are being rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman who has been changed and finds it funny.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Transformed' looks like the anagram signal but belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth a beautiful woman was turned by Athena into a snake-haired Gorgon.

clue.text: Element of spoken languages, a number

indicators.note: spoken says the word for languages is heard rather than written

parts.note: tongues are languages
ten is a number

explanation.surface: Spoken languages counted as a part of something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spoken' gives TUNGS, which sounds like TONGUES.
explanation.definitionFit: The metal with symbol W is a chemical element.

clue.text: Ma produces new device to keep house dry

indicators.note: new tells us the letters of the two words are made into something fresh

explanation.surface: Mother comes up with an invention for waterproofing the home.
explanation.definitionFit: A waterproof layer built into a wall stops ground moisture rising into a building.

clue.text: Gate outside Government ministry in a particular artistic style

indicators.note: outside means the gate word goes around the ministry abbreviation

parts.note: a postern is a back gate
MOD is the Ministry of Defence

explanation.surface: A gate standing outside a government building in an arty style.
explanation.walkthrough: MOD is the UK Ministry of Defence.
explanation.definitionFit: Late twentieth-century art and architecture rejecting modernism is described with this adjective.

clue.text: Hit that knocks chums over

indicators.note: knocks over here signals the word for chums is turned upside down, read backwards

parts.note: pals are chums

explanation.surface: A blow that sends friends tumbling.
explanation.definitionFit: A smack with the open hand is a hit.

clue.text: Unusually poised as saint, showing no emotion

indicators.note: unusually tells us the letters of the three words appear in an unexpected order

explanation.surface: Someone composed as a saint, calm and unmoved.
explanation.definitionFit: Calm, detached and unaffected by feeling is a synonym.

clue.text: Scene I love in play

indicators.note: in means the letters for I and love go inside the play word

parts.note: a drama is a play
love is zero in tennis, shaped like O

explanation.surface: An actor admiring a scene in a play.
explanation.definitionFit: A three-dimensional model of a scene, as in a museum, is this display.

clue.text: Soldiers on trip receiving any number of weapons etc

indicators.note: on in a down clue puts the soldiers above the rest

parts.note: OR, other ranks, means ordinary soldiers

indicators.note: receiving means the trip word takes the number letter inside

parts.note: to trip, as in trip the light fantastic, is to dance
N stands for any number in maths

explanation.surface: Troops on an outing taking a load of arms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' stacks the soldiers above in a down clue; 'receiving' takes the number inside the trip word. Other ranks are non-officer soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: Military supplies, especially guns and ammunition, go by this name.

clue.text: Supporting one particular gender and class

parts.note: to be for something is to support it
M stands for male

explanation.surface: Backing a single sex and a single school year.
explanation.definitionFit: In British schools a year group or class is called this.

clue.text: Base discovered at holy Scottish site, blocked off at end

parts.note: found means discovered

indicators.note: blocked off at end says the island name loses its final letter

parts.note: Iona is a Hebridean island famous for its abbey

explanation.surface: A Scottish monastery dug up and found sealed off at one end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blocked off at end' cuts IONA to ION.
explanation.definitionFit: The base a building stands on is a synonym.

clue.text: Upset about wild animal in prime of life?

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means the letters are turned over and read upwards

parts.note: re means about, as in business letters
a wolf is a wild animal

explanation.surface: Someone upset over a wild beast in the best years of life.
explanation.definitionFit: 'The flower of youth' means its best part, idiomatically the prime.

clue.text: Very big honour given to Home Counties

parts.note: an OBE is an Order of the British Empire award
the Home Counties around London lie in the south-east, SE

explanation.surface: An award presented to someone in the counties around London.
explanation.walkthrough: The Home Counties are the counties surrounding London.
explanation.definitionFit: Grossly overweight people are very big.

clue.text: What's transformed homes and is good-looking

indicators.note: transformed tells us the letters of homes and are rearranged

explanation.surface: A makeover programme that makes houses attractive.
explanation.definitionFit: Attractive, usually of a man, is this word.

clue.text: A long name for a German city

parts.note: to ache for something is to long for it

explanation.surface: A lengthy name for a city in Germany.
explanation.definitionFit: Charlemagne's capital lies in western Germany near Belgium.

clue.text: Church with fashionable feature

parts.note: something in is fashionable

explanation.surface: A trendy church whose look has a striking characteristic.
explanation.definitionFit: A part of the face is one of its features.

clue.text: Soldiers in time will give consent

indicators.note: in means the soldiers go inside the time word

parts.note: an age is a long time
RE is the Royal Engineers

explanation.surface: Troops will come round in time.
explanation.definitionFit: To say yes to a proposal is to give consent.

clue.text: Touching piece on games board, gripping part of play

indicators.note: gripping means the tile word holds the part of play inside

parts.note: a tile is a piece in games like Scrabble or mahjong
an act is a division of a play

explanation.surface: A board-game piece holding a scene from a drama.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Touching' suggests moving, but it means relating to touch.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to or perceived by the sense of touch.
